headline: S&P 500 records historic $2.9 trillion loss as tech sector selloff deepens
summary: The S&P 500 experienced its largest one-day market capitalization loss on record, driven by a sharp decline in technology stocks. The selloff marks the worst performance for the sector since 2020.
why: The S&P 500 is a benchmark index representing the performance of 500 large-cap companies listed on US stock exchanges, serving as a primary indicator of overall US equity market health.
why_moved: The significant decline in tech sector valuations triggered a broad-based selloff, resulting in the largest single-day market capitalization loss in the index's history.
